description: Fill a whole form in one call: text inputs, <select> (by value or visible label), checkboxes (boolean) and radio buttons. One round-trip; partial errors do not abort and each field reports its own status. On per-field errors call view_page and retry the failing fields.

fields.description: Each needs ref or selector plus value

value.description: string for text/select, boolean for checkbox/radio; number → string

name: fill_form
